35.text: The unit of value in Russian trade remains a bundle of tobacco “not

36.text: tampered with,” because the traders often abstract a few leaves and replace

37.text: the bindings. In recent years brick-tea has also come into use as a standard

38.text: of value, and is even preferred because of the uniform size of the bricks.

39.text: In the trade with whalers no particular unit is applied. Prices are very

40.text: variable, according to season and place. The same commodities are sold in
